```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol       ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv  ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
sums AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS revenue_cents
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id
),
oc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
),
vc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       oc.order_count,
       s.quantity,
       s.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM sums s
  JOIN oc ON oc.product_id = s.product_id
  JOIN vc ON vc.product_id = s.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
 ORDER BY s.quantity DESC, s.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De grote gesorteerde join-uitvoer (met schijf-spill door `count(DISTINCT)` op `p.id, o.id`) is vervangen door hash-aggregaties op de gefilterde basisset. Som, aantal orders en aantal varianten worden apart berekend en daarna gekoppeld aan `products`, dus alleen de resterende producten worden opgezocht. Kolomtypen, namen en volgorde blijven gelijk aan het origineel.
